pending_commit.commit_message: Add Parade PS8751 TCPC firmware version 0x3B canary package. This package is for canarying new Parade PS8751 TCPC firmware versions on a subset of USB ports on a device, ahead of updating the revision of the main parade-ps8751a3-firmware package on the device. This uses the same set of firmware binary blob tarballs as the main package. This exists separately so that two revisions can be installed concurrently. This also fulfills the requirement of unique filenames for CBFS, which lacks a directory structure. Note that there have been two different 0x3B builds distributed by Parade. This is intended to fetch the 0x3B from the linked bug. Submission of this CL commits us to never distributing the other 0x3B build. (We have asked Parade to avoid such version ambiguity going forward.) BUG=b:117787849 TEST=When combined with other changes, PS8751 FW version 0x3B is flashed to left side TCPC, while right side TCPC gets 0x39. After reflash, Servo v4 CCD USB PD pass-through begins to work. CRAS: fmt_conv: decouple fmt_conv and fmt_conv_ops Facts: 1. "struct cras_fmt_conv" is private for fmt_conv. 2. fmt_conv_ops no need to know the implementation details of "struct cras_fmt_conv". Decouple fmt_conv and fmt_conv_ops so that the caller (i.e. fmt_conv) won't need to grant whole access permission to "struct cras_fmt_conv" and the callees (i.e. fmt_conv_ops) can focus more on their logic. As a benefit, fmt_conv_ops are eaiser to test by unittests.
